---
title: Import Members
description: >-
  Download the required CSV template and upload your completed file to register
  multiple system members at once.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1378" height="761" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Members > Import Members.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="292" height="347" />

2. Download the provided CSV template to ensure your data matches the system's required format.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="490" height="352" />

3. Upload the completed file to register your members.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="490" height="340" />
